name: compaction-harness
title: Compaction Harness redesign
description: Audit and redesign TakiAgent's Compaction Harness around token-first Replay View boundaries, independent of Memory Provider lifecycle, using the verified DSH compaction/token-meter patterns while preserving Character-scoped companion continuity and one common Run/Turn runtime.
scope: packages/core replay/compaction/context management, Memory composition boundary, DSH comparison research, planning artifacts and regression design; no D68-B UI implementation
creator: pleia
notes: Research is complete in research/current-compaction-design.md and research/dsh-compaction-design.md. Slices 1 and 2 are implemented and formally checked: measured Replay View source loading is token-first; compaction retirement uses a DSH-grounded 0.16 priced tail with balanced tool units; Legacy and canonical Local share one Core-owned detached compaction chain; every Legacy background model call uses the process-wide Utility Slot; and MemoryFlushPort outcomes are explicit and fail-closed. Slice 2 evidence: 70 focused tests; Core 286 files / 1804 passed / 1 skipped; workspace typecheck, root lint, isolated Core boot, task validation, and git diff --check passed. Planning preserves T5 R2 as the current overflow baseline and keeps the overall task active for durable Slice 3 and quality Slice 4 work; no task-level owner acceptance is implied.
